ar.mode: forced decoding: the NCM sample's tokens are fed one per call through the AR's key/value-cached step (BOS first), so call n writes token n of the same text; not an independent AR sample
ar.logprob_note: Natural-log probabilities the AR assigns to each NCM token at the call that writes it; the summary covers the text up to the end-of-story token. They show how the AR scores this text and are not drawn in the figure.

sample_rule: The first of the seed's NCM samples (lowest index) whose first sentence is well formed: it starts with a capital, has 5 to 30 words, ends in . ! or ? and has no repeated word, doubled punctuation or stray characters. The AR replays that sample.
counting: Model calls are forward passes of the transformer that writes the output: one per generated level for NCM, one per token for AR. They are counted, not timed; an NCM call is larger than an AR call, and NCM adds a codec decode at the end.
